fuelTypeLabel.en: To confirm (fuel-cap label / rental contract); conservatively treated as petrol

sourceZh: 车型已由取车照片确认：Škoda Kodiaq 4x4，车牌 XR 72427（与 SIXT 合同号一致）。取车时仪表：总里程 53,060 km，剩余续航 890 km。燃油类型与油耗仍待确认，故继续使用保守估算（8.5 L/100km、55 L），确认后再更新。
sourceEn: Model confirmed from pickup photos: Škoda Kodiaq 4x4, plate XR 72427 (matches the SIXT contract number). Dashboard at pickup: odometer 53,060 km, range 890 km. Fuel type and consumption still to confirm, so the conservative estimate (8.5 L/100 km, 55 L) stays until then.
